title: Pirate's Plunder community event

facts.statement: A community event in Seaside invited members to play the Pirate's Plunder minigame, collecting gold and capturing a prize, with a party on the pier and beach.
facts.quote: Gather yer crew on the shores of Seaside and party on the pier! Members can try their luck at the Pirate's Plunder minigame.

facts.statement: The event ran on Thursday February 3rd, 2011 at 3pm Pacific Time for U.S. and Latin America, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday February 3rd, 2011 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The event ran on Friday February 4th, 2011 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) for UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday February 4th, 2011 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Pirate's Plunder!
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community event post announcing a Pirate's Plunder event on the Seaside shores, where members could play the Pirate's Plunder minigame. The event ran on Server 1 on two dates, one for the U.S. and Latin America and one for the UK and Europe. The post's relative posting age does not pin an exact posting date.

quest_answers_mentioning_it: No Prey, No Pay (final, live yes)
